verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere runs a hosted API (Wally Cloud), so a downloadable machine-readable spec is a fair thing to ask for. However, every probed OpenAPI/Swagger path returned 404, and no doc mentions a published spec. Being OpenAI-compatible means relying on OpenAI's spec rather than a first-party one, and llms.txt is a documentation index, not an API spec, so neither earns credit.
